name: GhostFileUploadTrigger
description: Native button (type=button) that opens the file picker; the keyboard and assistive-technology control. Receives the root id and aria-describedby, sets aria-invalid when invalid, and inside GhostField composes aria-labelledby from the Field label and its own text unless the consumer names it.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables this trigger only; combines with the root `disabled`.

slots.name: default
slots.description: Visible button text, for example Choose files.

states.name: invalid
states.description: Root is invalid. Wins over disabled.

keyboard.Tab: Moves to the trigger, then to each remove button in DOM order.

spec.evidence: Zac approved the GHO-106 design plan in chat on 2026-11-17 (recorded in GHO-210), including its six review points. See the Status line in this spec.
